spec.headline: The Liquidation Trap: $159M TVL Meets $1.2M Swap Depth

blocks.text: Seizure: Debt threshold breach activates liquidation against $159,033,033 Blend TVL
Funnel: Liquidators route seized collateral to decentralized exchange pools
Bottleneck: Swap depth exhausts against $1,239,028 Soroswap TVL
Bad Debt: Slippage exceeds liquidation incentive, leaving underwater loans unsettled

focal.reason: Exposes the fatal 128:1 liquidity mismatch where onchain liquidation capacity fails.

defects.issue: Severe bottom dead space and vertical imbalance
defects.reason: All content is clustered in the top 60% of the canvas, leaving the bottom third entirely vacant and visually dead rather than intentionally spaced.
defects.fix: Increase vertical padding between sequence blocks 01-04 from 28px to 52px and shift the entire sequence group down by 80px to balance positive and negative space across the square frame.

defects.issue: Sub-accessible text contrast on secondary list items
defects.reason: The muted grey body copy is dimmed excessively against the near-black background, impairing legibility on mobile viewports.
defects.fix: Increase inactive item text luminance from ~35% grey to #9DA4B0 (approx 65% luminance), retaining 100% white (#FFFFFF) exclusively on item 03.

defects.location: Vertical lavender line to the left of the numbered list
defects.reason: The thin vertical indicator extends past item 04 into empty space without termination nodes, looking like an unanchored UI artifact.
defects.fix: Clamp the vertical line top to the cap-height of '01' and bottom to the baseline of '04', or add subtle 4px node ticks aligned to each step number.
